title: Ghana Just Legalized Crypto Trading – Here’s the Catch
summary: Ghana has legalized cryptocurrency trading, ending years of uncertainty and placing exchanges and other virtual asset firms under Bank of Ghana licensing, supervision, and compliance rules.
